entities.name: Elina Quins
entities.description: Eldrich Aldercrest's romantic interest who lived a normal life and died of old age.
entities.quote: Eldrich's love interests name was Elina Quins and cousin name is Soa Aldercrest and the judgement power is called Athenas Judgement by the aldercrest.

updates.new_facts: Became half-demon after Khalid came for revenge, did not age much, and visits graves of Elina, Dorian, his father, and Norman.
updates.quote: after the death of dorian cross and later when khalid came for revenge on eldrich and made him half demonic ,like a curse.from that moment eldrich vanished as if he was never there.

updates.new_facts: Considered a friend by Eldrich, though Eldrich views him as a puppet controlled by agony and created a symbolic grave for him.
updates.quote: norman was convinced that he was a victim.but even after fight,eldrich always counted him as a friend.but he also knows the friend is long dead,the person is now a puppet,controlled by agony.

updates.new_facts: Eldrich's cousin who died young by suicide due to pressure from the Aldercrest regarding her rare judgement power called Athena's Judgement.
updates.quote: Soa Aldercrest Eldrich’s cousin Died young by suicide Had double Golden Eyes Power: Athena’s Judgement Destroyed by Aldercrest pressure, not villains

updates.new_facts: Offered Dorian and his team to be a dragon slayer, knowing Dorian was highly potential and one of the best in his young age.
updates.quote: do you know even tedmond knew dorian . and he offered him with his team to he a dragon slayer. where tedmond also knew dorian was highly potential.
